text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright chose to improve at her own pace, but she still has a very long way to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I arrange for her to partner run with her classmate, Seeking the Pearl, but she ultimately loses. Our days of endless training continue…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Until one day, everything changes. Mejiro Bright suddenly runs in a way I've never seen from her before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out, she's experiencing pain in her legs due to her growth. Deciding not to push herself until the pain subsides, she waits until it's gone to spread her wings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's able to make a full recovery because of that. I now understand why she's been intent on taking her time.
